# StartupOnX India
> A curated directory of Indian startups building in public. Founders pay Rs149/month to get listed. No ranking by money. No algorithm.

## What this site is
StartupOnX India (startuponx.com) is India's startup directory for founders building in public. It lists verified Indian startups across categories including AI, SaaS, Fintech, Developer Tools, Design, Marketing, and Productivity.

## Who it is for
- Indian founders who want their startup discovered by users, investors, and other founders
- Investors and users looking for Indian startups to follow or try
- Anyone curious about what Indian founders are building right now

## How it works
1. Founder signs in with Google
2. Submits startup name, one-liner, website, category, and logo
3. Pays Rs149/month via UPI
4. Listing goes live within 24 hours after manual review

## Pricing
- Founding member price: Rs149/month (first 25 founders, locked forever)
- Standard price: Rs299/month
